## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak overall breadth (3/11) and narrow leadership concentration (Top 5 dominated by Technology), with a major divergence across large caps (MSFT, AMZN, IBM, MA showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) — tactical caution advised.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND. Technology is also positive but narrow: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND — Tech breadth: mixed (approx 12/24 positive).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials, Consumer Staples and Industrials are weakest: Materials headline laggards FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND and PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND. Industrials underperform with UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND and CAT (1W: -8.34% | 1M: -1.58%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND. Watch divergences: IBM (1W: +7.76% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY and AMZN (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -8.49%) RECOVERY — MAJOR DIVERGENCE present, so treat rallies as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and narrow: AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND. Technology breadth: mixed (approx 12/24 positive); selective leadership, not broad participation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak on the week: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY — sector shows internal stress with more names below trend. Financials breadth: weak (few leaders), contributing to the CAUTION regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive signals faded: JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION. Healthcare breadth: mixed-to-weak (several large names showing exhaustion or pullback).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and the handful of confirmed Tech winners (INTU, ADBE, MPC) and reduce exposure to large-cap growth names showing persistent weakness (AAPL, GOOGL, META). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; with narrow Tech leadership and major divergences, prefer selective trimming and monitoring rather than broad re-risking.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/anthropic deal momentum confirming price; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND — energy strength to watch. BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum and negative headlines to monitor.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (sector 1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.83%) — positive multi-week trend to favor exposure. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples — both showing clear 1W weakness and concentration of laggards.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
INTU immediate follow-through above the recent breakout (monitor 1W momentum continuation). AAPL downside near recent 1M lows is a risk level for tech leadership rotation. NVDA staying ABOVE TREND is a trigger for broader Tech stabilization; failure would increase downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (+75): strong Q and Anthropic AI deal — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) confirming sentiment. PFE (+75): China obesity nod and cancer wins — price CORRECTION (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) sentiment partly confirming fundamental catalyst but short-term pullback. RTX (+60): defense contract wins — RTX showing strength intraday (use as watch list for industrial exposure).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-60): legal/exec turnover headlines — PYPL showing pressure in recent sessions (monitor for trend break). ORCL (-50): negative headlines on large project scrutiny — Oracle price weakness is a distribution risk versus recent gains. MNST (-50): earnings disappointment — price BELOW TREND (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) confirming bearish sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership as weak breadth (3/11) and narrow Tech-led rallies conflict with widespread sector weakness. INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND and MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (MSFT, AMZN, IBM, MA in RECOVERY) and negative headlines on MNST/ORCL — monitor for trend confirmation before increasing risk.
